title: Content fragments (DAM) → EDS fragment documents
decisions: Every content fragment used inside an XF becomes its own fragment document at cfToFragmentPath() (/us/en/fragments/content-fragments/...).
Each document holds ALL the fragment's fields (from .migration/cf-content).

Where a use shows only some fields (elementNames; 2 of 55 fragments: global-headquarters, primary-contact), the containing fragment shows that subset — handled in the import, so content stays one-to-one with AEM.
